name: @afl-lang/core
description: Reference parser, validator, and runtime for Agent Flow Language IR

scripts.test:cli: node bin/afl.mjs validate test/fixtures/echo.afl && node bin/afl.mjs run test/fixtures/echo.afl --args '["hello"]' --run-id cli-test
scripts.smoke:deepseek: npm run build && node bin/afl.mjs run examples/live-smoke.afl --adapter examples/deepseek-bindings.mjs --args '["Reply with exactly: afl-live-ok"]'
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:cli
